summary: The old harness cannot exercise the supported saved-comment mode on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: Saved comments are supported during string parsing. A finite input such as "#x\nk=1;" can trigger saving and attachment when UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is enabled. The complete old harness always calls ucl_parser_new(0) and has no other setup route, so input bytes cannot enable the mode.

before.requirement: Construct the string parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS enabled so parsed input comments can be saved and attached.
before.reason: The before source defines and guards saved-comment parsing. The string call reaches the UCL state machine, but the harness supplies zero constructor flags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the saved-comment flag as distinct from the zero default.
Saves an input comment only when the flag is set.
Stores constructor flags and creates comment storage only for saved-comment mode.
The string call's UCL chunk reaches the state machine.

after.requirement: Construct the string parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS enabled so parsed input comments can be saved and attached.
after.reason: Saved-comment parsing remains supported, including the changed handling of a pending comment. The fixed old harness still supplies zero constructor flags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the saved-comment flag as distinct from the zero default.
Saves an input comment only when the flag is set.
Stores constructor flags and creates comment storage only for saved-comment mode.
The selected cleanup change also handles a pending saved comment.
The string call's UCL chunk reaches the state machine.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same ucl_parser_new(0) call prevents saved-comment mode on both versions.
